entities.summary: Western Bulgarian Empire, a political institution in Bulgaria during First Bulgarian Empire (927–1018). Grew from Reign of Simeon the Great — Bulgarian Golden Age and Boris I adopts Christianity. Led to the emergence of Decline & Byzantine Conquest.
